question: A shopkeeper sold a pen for ₹150 and made a profit of ₹30. Find the cost price of the pen.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Selling Price (SP) = ₹150

Profit = ₹30

Direct Logic: Cost Price (CP) = SP − Profit

CP = 150 − 30 = 120

**∴ The correct answer is ₹120.**
